purpose: Evaluates each volume-handling safety property against executable proof (public-signal-prioritisation.test.ts unit + multi-signal-volume-prioritisation.db.test.ts DB).

properties.how: repeated weak signals stay REPEATED_WEAK → reassessment/validation; volume raises validation urgency, not certainty.
same-topic/duplicate signals collapse; one governed task per actionable cluster (51→3, 30→3, 26→4).
transparent priority tiers (1–9) with explicit reasons; severe unresolved quality/cash/capacity/legal always outranks growth/pricing.
growth/marketing/expansion never the top action while an unresolved risk exists; scale blocked-before-proof.
tender → data-first (tier 6); auto-submit blocked regardless of deadline urgency.
cash/profit missing-data outranks discount/growth; no fabricated money.
PII stripped upstream and never carried into clusters/cockpit/task/audit.
injection blocked and never affects priority or authority.
money/ROI/win-probability/MRR blocked and never a governed figure.
one top action + grouped secondaries + monitor summary; no raw-signal dump.
each workspace's clustered tasks are scoped to it; the tender task never leaks into laundry.
no signals → prioritise returns null; the workspace persists nothing.
